title: Mood Cloud: a desk lamp that shows tomorrow's weather
purpose: Glow blue the evening before it rains, and give a soft night light the rest of the time
users: Someone who wants a calm weather hint on the desk or the bedside
form_factor: Cloud-shaped desk lamp, about 18 cm wide, matte white shell

features.text: Glows blue the evening before it rains
features.note: Tomorrow's forecast over Wi-Fi from a weather service

features.text: Soft white night light that dims on a schedule
Tap the top to switch moods
features.note: A touch pad under the shell, no visible button

features.text: Small speaker for a soft rain chime
features.note: A gentle buzzer tone; a speaker with an amplifier is also possible if you want real sounds

features.text: 2-day battery so it can sit anywhere
features.note: Our gadgets run from USB-C power; there are no batteries in the catalog today

text_seen: MOOD CLOUD. concept sheet v0.2 - a desk lamp that shows tomorrow's weather. RGB LED ring inside: blue = rain tomorrow. tap the top to change the mood. USB-C power at the back. Wi-Fi: weather from the internet. FEATURES: Glows blue the evening before it rains; Soft white night light, dims on a schedule; Tap the top to switch moods; Small speaker: a soft chime for rain; 2-day battery so it can sit anywhere; About 18 cm wide, matte white shell. made with an AI image tool - not to scale
out_of_scope: A built-in battery: Wish Labs gadgets are powered over USB-C

closest_buildable.title: Mood Cloud (USB-C)
closest_buildable.summary: The same cloud lamp on a USB-C cable: weather glow, schedule night light, tap to switch moods and a soft buzzer chime.
